purpose: Bind the nominal published Proust apparatus dimensions to the development-only source-line-valve-terminal network without changing the frozen direct-aperture holdout.
claim_boundary: This adapter is a reproducibility aid for future apparatus-resolved data. It is not external validation, does not repair the negative Proust holdout, and does not support a safety-distance or controller claim.

source.citation: Proust, Jamois and Studer, High pressure hydrogen fires, DOI 10.1016/j.ijhydene.2010.04.055
source.derived_geometry_warning: Nominal dimensions only; replace with as-built bore and measured dead volume when available.

implementation.terminal_discharge_coefficient_note: Inherited development convention from the direct-aperture evaluator; not a measured Proust value.

missing_evidence: as-built line bore and dead volume
complete valve position trace and valve location declaration
line pressure and line temperature channels
promotion_rule: Do not promote this adapter to validation or production until a prospective, rights-cleared apparatus logger satisfies research/apparatus_resolved_release_protocol.json and the frozen holdout is rerun before outcome inspection.
